title_sq: Shitet Vile ne Peze e Vogel te Lapidari.

Shitet vile tre kateshe ne Peze e Vogel te Lapidari.

title_en: Villa for sale in Peze e Vogel, Lapidari.
description_en: Three-story villa for sale in Peze e Vogel, Lapidari. Land surface 400m2, with construction area 74.7m2, organized on 3 floors. First floor - entrance hall, toilet, large living room and kitchen. Second floor two bedrooms and bathroom. The third floor is an open space and toilet, parrot type. In the yard there is an 8m deep water well which is used for the service of the property. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For a visit to the property, please contact us!
